description: Conversion from six person HMO (Class C4) to eight person HMO (Sui Generis)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span style="text-align: justify;">The proposed
change of use to an 8-bedroom House in Multiple Occupation (Sui Generis) has
failed to demonstrate that the servicing, refuse and recycling storage, cycle
parking and associated hard and soft landscaping required to support the
development can be accommodated within the site in a manner which would
maintain an attractive frontage and preserve the character and appearance of
the surrounding residential area. By virtue of insufficient information
regarding the design, capacity and integration of this infrastructure within
the site, the Local Planning Authority is unable to conclude that the proposal
would provide a satisfactory design-led solution or comply with criteria (4)
and (10) of Policy HO10. The proposal therefore conflicts with Paragraphs 135
and 139 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Plan Policy D3,
Strategic Policy 01 and Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041), and
criteria (4) and (10) of Policy HO10 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</span></p>

<p>The proposed change of
use from a small House in Multiple Occupation (Use Class C4) to a large House
in Multiple Occupation (Sui Generis) would result in an intensified form of
residential occupation in a location that is not considered suitable for such
development. The site is located within a Public Transport Accessibility Level
(PTAL) 2 area and is situated within a residential street characterised
predominantly by family housing. The proposal therefore conflicts with criteria
(2) and (3) of Policy HO10 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041), which seek to
direct larger HMOs to sustainable locations with higher levels of public
transport accessibility and away from areas characterised by family housing.
The proposal is also contrary to the spatial objectives of London Plan (2021) Policies
H1 and H9 and would represent an unacceptable form of development in principle.</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The proposed
change of use to an 8-bedroom House in Multiple Occupation (Sui Generis) would
result in an intensified form of residential occupation which, by virtue of the
scale of the use and the resulting increase in comings and goings, activity and
general disturbance associated with the occupation of the property by up to
eight unrelated individuals, would be detrimental to the living conditions of
neighbouring occupiers. The proposal is therefore contrary to Paragraphs 135
and 198 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Plan Policies D13 and
D14, Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041) and criterion (4) of
Policy HO10 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>The proposed change of use to an 8-bedroom House in Multiple Occupation (Sui Generis) would result in an inadequate level of communal accommodation for future occupiers, by virtue of the increase in occupancy from six to eight residents and the loss of existing shared living accommodation, including a lounge and additional kitchen/shared space, leaving only a single communal kitchen/living area to serve all occupiers. The proposal would therefore represent an over-intensive form of development that would fail to provide a satisfactory standard of residential accommodation and would not function well over its lifetime. The proposal is therefore contrary to Paragraphs 135 and 139 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Plan Policies D3 and D6, and Policies GR1(C) and HO10 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
